issue.title: Successor Links: a closed planned task hands its slot to the tasks it unblocks
issue.description: When a Bob close gesture completes a task planned in today's ledger, every direct dependent that this close fully unblocked is linked into the predecessor's slot and becomes Next in the same write. Bob close gestures are Obsidian Ctrl+Enter, `bob capture` `!note:id`, and the `=x…` / `=!` Pomodoro closes. The slot is right after the predecessor's Task Link, or the same-name continuation when the whole session closed. One grouped notice says what was linked, where, and why: a card in Obsidian, the live preview plus one notification line in Bob Mac Capture, and rows in the CLI. Capture gets faster, not slower: on apollo, plain and `=x` previews take ≤ 40 ms, and closing a real prerequisite takes ≤ 70 ms.
